name: Neon Nights Festival
description: An open-air electronic music festival across three stages. Doors 6pm, headline set 10pm. Over-18s only; bring ID.

name: The Midnight Symphony
description: A candlelit orchestral evening pairing film scores with classical favourites. Seated, all ages welcome.

name: Cup Final: Rovers vs City
description: The derby that decides the season. Segregated home and away ends. Turnstiles open two hours before kick-off.

name: Stand-Up Live: Late Set
description: An intimate late-night stand-up showcase with five acts and a surprise headliner. Strong language throughout.
